title: Size bound for the configuration circuit
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-state binary Turing machine with $k$ work tapes, let $n,T\in\mathbb{N}$, and let $\ell$ be a finite list of bit sources. Let $K$ be the maximum, over the finitely many instruction kinds of the configuration computation for $M$, of the total width of the circuits used to compute that instruction's output bits. Then the size of the configuration circuit is at most $n+2+(T+1)\bigl(k(2T+1)+|\ell|+3\bigr)K$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite-state Turing machine over bits
$\ell$ is a finite list of bit sources
caveat: The bound uses a machine-dependent finite supremum of instruction-gadget widths; this is rendered as their maximum $K$.
